description: validate_path checks anchor.subject_public_key_info == last_cert.subject_public_key_info when the last cert is self-issued. A contributor might remove this as 'redundant with signature verification'. It is not: signature verification returns SignatureInvalid, not NoTrustedPath; the guard ensures a key-collision attacker cannot craft a different-SPKI root that passes name matching and then survives sig verification under a different anchor.
title: SPKI guard for self-issued certs prevents name-collision attack
